175776.overview: Real life simulation game. Equip and run your own North Sea Oil rig. How fast can you make 100 million dollars? Written by an offshore engineer.

446549.overview: You are one of the last human survivors of the planet Nerble. All of your comrades are on the surface of the planet while you are in the only remaining human spaceship. Your task is to defend the humans against the Nerble Force. The player controls a small vessel that moves in all directions, and fires horizontally. The screen scrolls horizontally, and enemy and human location are shown on a small map at the bottom of the screen. Grabbers try to capture men on the bottom of the screen, and if they bring them to the top they become wigglers. If a grabber is shot before it reaches the top of the screen, the man falls to the grounds, and must be caught and safely lowered to the ground. If the grabber reaches the top of the screen with a captured man, it becomes a wiggler, and attacks the player. Miners move diagonally and leave deadly mines on the screen, and chasers barrel straight towards the player.

446566.overview: The player attempts to take off, fly, and then land their aircraft at night using only their instrument displays and lighted runway to assist them. The player selects available fuel and wind variables at the beginning of the flight. The player can control the bank and attitude of their aircraft, increase or decrease power, increase or decrease their flaps, and can bring up or down their undercart.
